title: Toye Cottage Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Check out Toye Cottage a beachside cottage south of 30A in Seaside, Florida with stunning gulf views, incredible outdoor spaces, outdoor dining and recent updates throughout!
description_expanded: Description2454 East County Hwy. 30A2 QUEEN BEDS, 1 DOUBLE BEDA Completely Renovated Original Seaside Cottage with Gulf ViewsOne of Seaside’s original homes, Toye Cottage has been completely renovated and thoughtfully reimagined while preserving its iconic charm. Bursting with color and natural light, the home is filled with windows that showcase Gulf of Mexico and Seaside views, along with inviting porches and patios on every level. This is the kind of beach home guests dream of finding—timeless, vibrant, and effortlessly welcoming.First-Floor Bedroom SuitesThe first floor offers three beautifully renovated bedrooms designed for comfort and privacy. The queen primary suite features a charming sitting area, a double-sided fireplace, two flat-screen TVs, and a fully renovated marble ensuite bath with a double vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Also on this level is a double guest bedroom that shares a newly renovated hall bathroom with a single vanity and a spacious glass-enclosed walk-in shower. At the front of the home, a queen bedroom enjoys its own ensuite bath with a single vanity, glass-enclosed walk-in shower, and an oversized luxurious rain shower head.Light-Filled Living, Dining & Kitchen on the Second FloorUpstairs, the second floor opens to a chic living room furnished with two large, comfortable sofas and a large flat-screen TV. Just off the living area, a screened porch provides a relaxing outdoor lounge with two sofas and a club chair—perfect for morning coffee while listening to the waves roll in.Adjacent to the living room is a dining area with seating for six, leading into a completely renovated, magazine-worthy kitchen. Surrounded by windows with stunning views of coastal dunes, lush vegetation, and glimpses of the Gulf, the kitchen features high-end stainless steel appliances, a five-burner gas stove, farmhouse sink, and a large center island with seating for two—a favorite gathering spot for guests. A convenient half bath and stackable washer and dryer are also located on this level.Expansive Outdoor Deck with Gulf Views & Alfresco DiningAlso on the second floor, an expanded outdoor deck offers outdoor dining for six with incredible Gulf views, privacy curtains, and a pergola. Additional bar seating for two provides yet another place to take in the scenery, while an outdoor gas grill makes this space ideal for relaxed al fresco meals. Just steps from the Tupelo Beach Pavilion, this elevated retreat allows you to unwind to the soothing sounds of the Gulf, day or night.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Bk, and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall, 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Please note that from March 9th to April 6th, Toye Cottage is only available for Family Break bookings or two adult couples. Each party booking is limited to two occupants 25 years old or older and their accompanying children. All occupants are required to sign in at time of arrival as part of our normal greeting process. FEATURES1,706 square feet of beautifully designed living spaceAccess to the private residential Seaside beach at Tupelo PavilionJust 98 feet (approximately a 1-minute walk) to beach accessPrivate off-street parking for two vehicles in a designated drivewayOutdoor gas grill for easy coastal cookoutsExpansive deck with outdoor dining for sixRecently renovated throughout, featuring a chef’s kitchenAccess to 3 community swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), along with a fitness centerWelcome tote including two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedGolf cart policy: Golf carts are considered vehicles and are not permitted for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances or medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002145
